column1: # (internal/storage/store/parent_liveness_registry_test.go). Each row is a (site, child, parent)
# triple: a storage function that INSERTs (Create/FirstOrCreate) or un-deletes a child row whose
# model has an FK to a soft-deletable/disableable parent, without lockLiveParent on that parent in
# the same function and transaction. "*" in site and parent = a model-level exemption (the child
# carries no authority at all). Classified 2026-10-04 against main + every open race-fix PR
# merged: what the parent's delete/disable sweeps, whether the write is serialized against it, and
# whether every read that honours the child re-validates the parent.
#   UNSAFE-OPEN          a real race; the reason names the tracking issue.
#   SAFE-HISTORY         append-only/display record; confers no authority.
#   SAFE-INERT           the parent's delete does not sweep this child (so a racing insert equals one
#                        made just before the delete), and/or every read that honours it re-validates
#   SAFE-NAMED-LOCK      serialized against the parent's delete by a shared WithNamedLock and an
#   SAFE-SAME-TX         the parent is created/restored in the same transaction.
#   SAFE-CALLER-LOCKS    a helper whose only caller calls lockLiveParent in the same transaction.
#   SAFE-PARENT-PROXY    a lockLiveParent on an intermediate parent whose own liveness the
#                        grandparent's delete sets under the same lock order.
#   SAFE-NON-ACTIVE-BRANCH  the unchecked insert is a non-authority branch of a checked site.
# `pending: #N` = the site disappears when race-fix PR #N merges (delete the row then);
# `ahead: #N` = the row is pre-added for a site/justification #N introduces (drop the marker then).
# Both carry expires=2026-10-18 and are exempt from the stale-row check.
